page.overview:
Who is John Moore-Brabazon?

John Moore-Brabazon (ジョン・ムーア＝ブラバゾン Jon mūa burabazon) is a good friend of George Joestar, who is featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He shares his passion of working on cars as a private mechanic. He becomes a great friend with Jorge and later on becomes the first Englishman to fly an airplane officially at the , and later becomes a politician.

36|birthday=February 8th, 1886|gender=Male|nation=British|occupation=Pilot Engineer Politician|status=Alive|noveldebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 9: Cliff|hair=Blonde|namesake=|ja_kanji=ジョン・ムーア＝ブラバゾン|ja_romaji=Jon mūa burabazon

John is a tall, fit man. he has slicked blonde hair. He is seen wearing a suit, though when he flies, he has a pilot hat with the letter ¨B¨ embedded onto it.

John is very rich, and smart. He is a mechanic, and owns seven cars. When he was in college, John was rude and immature, like throwing a wrench at Jorge's car. He can be quite competitive, and enjoys working on cars.
